pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: lib/db/config.ts:14 lib/db only picks and runs the embedded PGlite store driver for in-process loaders and exposes no tool protocol. A case-insensitive search of lib/db for mcp, json-rpc, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema, callTool and listTools found nothing (the one 'stdio' hit is a child-process option in a durability test), so no technique's precondition holds.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: scripts/data-analysis/kg-promote.ts:16 kg-promote and its sibling writers are operator-run tsx CLI scripts. They read static verdict JSON files and upsert into kg_node/kg_edge. No model calls them through a tool protocol, and a search of scripts/data-analysis for mcp, json-rpc, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, inputSchema, tool_use and callTool found nothing.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: lib/security/token.ts:6 The security layer protects only two human operator surfaces (the money review write path and the admin console) with a shared token. The routing and i18n helpers are plain parsers. A search of lib/routing, lib/i18n and lib/security for mcp, json-rpc, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call and inputSchema found nothing, so there is no tool server whose auth or schema the standard could govern.
